notes: «حدثني أبي وجماعة مشايخي» : the father is a relation link; «جماعة مشايخي» is an unnamed transmitter, like «عدة من أصحابنا»
«وغيره» is an unnamed co-transmitter in its level
«وَ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ» is a second isnad with the same saying («قالا»); its head is not written in the text, so it is read as the text writes it
the ending «قالا قالا» is the saying; the blessing after each Imam is not part of the surface
